Who We Are

SECURING THE FUTURE OF INDIA

Founded in 2008 to end mis-selling and bring transparency to financial services, Policybazaar is India's leading digital insurance marketplace. We blend cutting-edge technology with empathy to empower consumers, making financial protection accessible, understandable, and affordable for every household.

Our Vision

To build a healthy and well-protected India. We aim to be the nation's definitive platform for financial decisions, simplifying access to insurance and credit so that every household is completely shielded from life's uncertainties by 2047.

Our Mission

To build a robust safety net for Indian households. Driven by our goal of "Har Family Hogi Insured," we leverage data and tech to democratize access to financial products, ensuring transparent, informed, and consumer-first choices.

Perks Working With Us
Comprehensive Insurance

As an insurance leader, we ensure you and your dependents are fully covered with top-tier health, accident, and life insurance plans.

Flexible Work Policies

We focus on your impact, not just hours. Enjoy flexible schedules and generous leave policies designed to help you balance work and life.

Wealth Creation (ESOPs)

Be a true partner in our success. We offer highly competitive ESOPs to reward your dedication and help you share in our long-term growth.

On-Site Wellness & Care

Recharge with fully stocked cafeterias, modern fitness tie-ups, and regular in-house medical consultations for your holistic well-being.

Continuous Upskilling

Access premium learning platforms, comprehensive mentorship programs, and leadership training to rapidly accelerate your career trajectory.

Generous Parental Leave

We support our growing families with extended maternity and paternity leave, ensuring you have ample time for what matters the most.
